text: Why does a mill pay ₹8 more a kilo for some iron?
tts: Why does a mill pay eight rupees more a kilo for some iron?

text: The answer is inside the furnace.
Thin, rusty sheet oxidises away; thick, clean pieces return more steel.
tts: Thin, rusty sheet oxidizes away; thick, clean pieces return more steel.

text: So mills pay by grade: punchings top, light scrap last.
Keep heavy pieces apart, dry and free of dirt.
Same truck, same trip cost, but a tonne of punchings brings ₹8,000 more.
tts: Same truck, same trip cost, but a ton of punchings brings eight thousand rupees more.

text: Mills pay for the steel they get back.
